values.note: Yancey County's facility page: 'Temporarily Closed Due to Hurricane Helene', hours Closed every day; photos captioned 'Toe River Campground - Post Helene'. No reopening date published.

status.source: https://yanceycountync.gov/facilities/facility/details/Toe-River-Campground-5 ('Other: Temporarily Closed Due to Hurricane Helene'; Hours M-F/Sat/Sun 'Closed'), read 2026-10-22

note: Closed as of Oct 2026 (Hurricane Helene) and the riverside site looks scoured by the flood on satellite imagery; ring the county before planning. County campground on the Toe River outside Burnsville at 225 Patience Park Road; before the storm it had full-hookup, water/electric and primitive sites, mid-April to mid-October; alcohol-free. --Claude
summary: Still closed: the county's facility page reads 'Temporarily Closed Due to Hurricane Helene' with every day's hours 'Closed' and only post-Helene photos; no reopening date anywhere on the county site. Status confirmed (now manual, county page). Phones 828-284-9223 (matches) and 828-675-9369 listed. Pre-storm hookups/season left as recorded (the page no longer describes them).
flags: Temporarily closed since Hurricane Helene (Sept 2024), still 'Temporarily Closed Due to Hurricane Helene' on the county page 2026-10-22 with no reopening date: two seasons lost so far. A human may want to decide whether it is coming back.
